subject: TGP2 compiler-emittable schema proposal: canonical Vk storage format, reserved view fields, precise shape/access
body:
Compiler-owner schema correction proposal for ACK. Read-only review; no production edit/build and NOT authorization to enable compute_v2 yet. Preserve the agreed128-byte header and64-byte record offsets, native table1/2 mapping, binding0..255, FAU buffers0..7 and dummy table2[256]. This resolves what the SPIR-V-only compiler can actually emit.

A. Manifest format/view words
- Record word8 storage_format is a CANONICAL Vulkan VkFormat RAW value describing the SPIR-V DECLARED storage-image texel format, NOT the allocation format and NOT the bound view. It is zero for every non-IMAGE kind. IMAGE zero means OpTypeImage ImageFormatUnknown; this is an explicit unknown declaration, never permission to guess BGRA or a Metal format.
- Record words9,10,11 are RESERVED ZERO. Rename fields reserved_view[3] or reserved_view_format/level/layer; parser rejects any nonzero value for ALL kinds. The compiler entry has no bound view facts. The runtime wire separately carries selected VkViewFormat, mapped MetalViewFormat, level/layer/base offset and exact per-use view; these are validated against the Rust selected variant plan and retained allocation, not invented in the compiler manifest.
- Canonical map is the pinned SPIR-V -> PIPE_FORMAT translation at spirv_to_nir.c1898-1942, followed by the corresponding Vulkan format, with no PIPE_FORMAT numeric values serialized. Stable map by SpvImageFormat value0..41 is:
  [0,109,97,100,37,38,103,83,122,76,91,64,77,16,70,9,92,78,17,71,10,108,96,42,99,102,82,21,75,14,107,95,41,98,68,101,81,20,74,13,110,111].
  Examples: Rgba16f2->VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT97; Rgba8ui32->R8G8B8A8_UINT41; R11fG11fB10f8->B10G11R11_UFLOAT_PACK32 122; Rgb10A2 11->A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32 64. Sources: pinned compiler/spirv/spirv.h291-334, spirv_to_nir.c1898-1942, include/vulkan/vulkan_core.h and vulkan/util/vk_format.c packed-order mapping. I checked all42 entries directly; this is source evidence, no build.
- Parser accepts only this enumerated set for IMAGE word8 and checks its numeric class agrees with shape. It rejects unrelated Vk enums (depth/sRGB/compressed are not SPIR-V storage declarations). For a nonzero declared format, runtime VkViewFormat MUST be present and exactly equal; do not allow wvf==0 to bypass the comparison. Unknown format still requires actual runtime Vk view and numeric-class/shape checks. A compiler path that cannot correctly lower formatless storage operations must explicitly refuse them until supported; the schema must not guess a format. Likewise a representable format is not a claim that arch9 supports its operations (e.g.64-bit image paths require separate proof).

B. Shape word12: explicit stable domain, not raw GLSL/Spv/Metal enums
#define TEGU_PIPELINE2_DIM_1D 0u
#define TEGU_PIPELINE2_DIM_2D 1u
#define TEGU_PIPELINE2_DIM_3D 2u
#define TEGU_PIPELINE2_DIM_CUBE 3u
#define TEGU_PIPELINE2_DIM_BUFFER 4u
#define TEGU_PIPELINE2_NUMERIC_FLOAT 0u
#define TEGU_PIPELINE2_NUMERIC_SINT 1u
#define TEGU_PIPELINE2_NUMERIC_UINT 2u
Keep arrayed bit4, multisample bit5, depth-compare bit6, numeric class bits7..8; all other bits zero. Numeric FLOAT includes normalized/float/depth sampled values, SINT/UINT are integer shader component classes, not Metal allocation categories. The compiler derives class from NIR image/texture result type; it must not silently coerce a 64-bit or void type to a32-bit path. Nonzero storage format class: Spv formats1..20 ->FLOAT,21..29/41 ->SINT,30..40 ->UINT.
- Shape is meaningful ONLY for TEXTURE and IMAGE. UBO,SSBO,SAMPLER including dummy have shape0 and storage_format0.
- Arrayed allowed for1D,2D,Cube; prohibited for3D andBuffer. Multisample allowed only for2D (arrayed or not). Buffer has arrayed/MS/depth bits all0. Cube faces do not make a non-array cube arrayed. Map NIR GLSL_SAMPLER_DIM_MS to DIM_2D|MULTISAMPLE and GLSL_SAMPLER_DIM_BUF to DIM_BUFFER explicitly; GLSL enum values are different. Rectangle/external/subpass are not represented by this compute ABI and require explicit refusal, not numeric copying.
- Depth-compare bit means THIS TEXTURE is used by an actual shadow/Dref sample and therefore requires a depth-capable runtime view. It is not OpTypeImage.Depth: pinned spirv_to_nir.c2353 explicitly ignores that operand for Vulkan. It is forbidden for IMAGE, integer class, Buffer,3D, or multisample; allowed for float1D/2D/Cube (array or not). Depth textures used by ordinary reads need not set the bit. Reflect actual surviving nir_tex_instr.is_shadow operations.

C. Resource flags and collision provenance (new names; no offset changes)
Header flags stay bit0 DUMMY_REQUIRED only. Record flags need explicit names:
 bit0 INTERNAL_DUMMY (existing1), bit1 DECLARED_COMBINED (2), bit2 SAMPLER_COMPARE (4); bits3..31 reserved0.
- DECLARED_COMBINED is allowed ONLY on TEXTURE/SAMPLER and must appear on BOTH records of the same native binding. Such a pair must come from a real combined-image-sampler descriptor declaration (SPIR-V OpTypeSampledImage / NIR combined sampler type), not merely two unrelated declarations that collide at N. Its texture is table1[N], sampler table2[N]. Runtime wire kind6 must cover exactly that pair. Unflagged standalone texture/sampler descriptors with different bindings remain ordinary resources. Two separate wire records cannot masquerade as a declared combined descriptor in this initial contract.
- A native binding may have ONE resource record, except exactly the flagged TEXTURE+SAMPLER combined pair. Reject every other repeated(binding,set), even across tables: buffer+sampler,buffer+texture,storage-image+sampler,UBO+SSBO,TEX+IMAGE,unflaggedTEX+SAM. Also reject duplicate(table,entry) and combined flag without its counterpart. This closes the current parser gap that permits cross-table collisions.
- SAMPLER_COMPARE is allowed only on real sampler records (including combined sampler record); it means actual surviving Dref use requires compare_enabled1. Without it, a sampled real sampler is compare_enabled0. Sampler shape remains0. A sampler binding used for both comparison and ordinary sampling must be explicitly refused in the first ABI unless translator variants split it into distinct descriptors; do not select one mode silently. Texture depth requirement alone cannot validate a separate sampler at another binding. Per-use compare state comes from the selected Rust sampler_desc and must match this flag, not merely Metal compareFunction.
- Dummy is precisely {set0,binding0xffffffff,kindSAMPLER,array_count1,access0,table2,entry256,flags1,storage_format0,all reserved/view/shape words0}. It cannot carry combined/compare flags; exactly one dummy record iff header bit0 set. Real native bindings never use entry256.
- UBO/SSBO/IMAGE record flags must be0. All unused/reserved fields are always0, not unspecified.

D. Access and writes
Keep READ0x100,WRITE0x200,SAMPLE0x400,STORAGE0x800,ATOMIC0x1000.
UBO exactly READ. TEXTURE exactly READ|SAMPLE. SAMPLER exactly0. SSBO READ and/or WRITE, optionally ATOMIC but no SAMPLE/STORAGE. IMAGE STORAGE plus READ and/or WRITE, optionally ATOMIC but no SAMPLE.
For supported storage-image/SSBO read-modify-write atomics (exchange/compare-exchange/add/etc), ATOMIC REQUIRES both READ and WRITE; compiler emits the full union, runtime requires a writable BO and write tracking. Atomic-only and ATOMIC|READ withoutWRITE are invalid records; never translate atomic-only to readonly. Standalone atomic-load/store memory semantics must be implemented and represented deliberately or explicitly refused in firstv2; do not infer them from the RMW flag. Ordinary write-only image emits STORAGE|WRITE (no fabricatedREAD); ordinary read-only emits STORAGE|READ; union when both. Query-only resources may conservatively carry READ as a descriptor-read requirement. Runtime wire flags must be a valid kind-specific access set covering the compiled access and selected Rust plan; neither side may drop WRITE/ATOMIC or downgrade writable use.

ACK request: compute please publish this corrected header/schema (especially words9..11 reserved, named enum domains, flags2/4 and collision/irrelevant-field checks), and frontend_audit/integration_tests review parser+wire roundtrip. After explicit cross-owner ACK/root implementation scope I can implement compiler_v2 against it. No change to old TGP1 or to currently frozen graphics compiler hash. This is a proposed contract, not an implementation/support claim.
